candidate_selection: Choose only after completed discovery and matched native ARC comparisons. If no meaningful advantage over tuned native ARC is demonstrated, do not manufacture an extension endorsement.
live_profile: Support-service prompt, no replay or application output cap, natural EOS, actual generated responses in subsequent context. Context-window overflow and length terminations count as failed workflows, never silently excluded.
comparison: Include original measured-style instrumented ARC for historical continuity AND tuned native ARC under common runtime overlay; include matched GPU and CPU capacity native controls to isolate advice. Generic runtime gains must be labelled generic.
confirmation_if_justified: Freeze candidate source, driver, runtime, model, hardware geometry and config. Twelve fresh workflow pairs, order balanced across pairs and two disjoint held-out chat partitions2207/3301. No favorable early stopping. If source/config changes, restart fresh inference or label prior runs discovery.
primary_measure: Complete natural-EOS workflow/time (fixed72planned requests); token throughput also reported alongside total generated tokens. Natural output variability cannot be labelled a compute win by itself.
latency: Queue-inclusive request-to-first-token mean/p95 and completion latency per workflow. Report paired intervals across whole workflows, not treating72requests as independent replications.
uncertainty: Paired whole-workflow log rates; paired absolute latency differences; intervals conditional on the fixed held-out inputs, not a population-wide production guarantee.
memory: Actual sampled serving NVML and reset CUDA allocated/reserved peak counters; startup memory separately; CPU cost reported where measured.
correctness: Separate intrusive real KV transfer byte comparison across all components, with executed one-byte corruption controls and both directions where demand restoration occurs. Audit-off does not emit lifecycle proofs. CPU ownership/failure/reset tests remain required.
quality: Report EOS/context outcomes, output lengths and degeneracy. Historical tool observations are not executed tools and do not establish agent task success. No claim of answer-quality equivalence from replay or byte tests alone.
completion_judgment: Lead and independent Astra must explain why measured benefits, latency behavior, resource costs and tested operational envelope justify a specific real workload. No numeric benefit floor invented for the user.
operational_limits: TP1 RTX2080Ti FP16 AWQ; pinned runtime overlays required. Registry capacity4096 session identities is fail closed, no expiry; resetting/recycling must be accounted for. Audited metadata mode remains research-oriented.
measurement_symmetry: Mandatory before confirmation: lean symmetric hooks in both arms, no periodic GPU residency scans or optional readmission/lookup observers; retain common client latency clocks, external NVML polling, native CUDA reset/export peak counters and matched scalar counters. Current discovery native comparisons have asymmetric GPU scans and cannot support a small benefit claim. Do not subtract overlapping instrumentation timings from end-to-end results.
native_correctness_normalization: The installed prerelease native finished-store path can use sampled-but-uncomputed final tokens; extension clamps to computed minus in-flight tokens. Before final H2D-heavy comparisons, native control must use the same finished-token boundary guard (pinned and explicitly labelled normalized native), or an independently qualified common contract. Raw transfer byte equality alone cannot prove that copied source KV corresponds to a computed token. Do not attribute observed natural-output divergence to this bug without direct exposure evidence.
retention_opportunity: A retention-benefit claim requires evidence of CPU eviction plus actual demand restoration or avoided recomputation; CPU eviction alone is insufficient if GPU prefixes remain resident. Current4096CPUblock graph chat runs have zeroCPUevictions and virtually noH2D, so they qualify generic graph acceleration rather than advice usefulness.
